note: Collections beyond the morning and evening adhkaar. Items with "ref" reuse an entry from adhkaar.json (its morning wording), optionally overriding "count" and "virtue". MUST be proofread by a qualified person before release.

completion.headline:
Your prayer,
sealed with dhikr
completion.quote: Whoever glorifies Allah after every prayer thirty-three times, praises Him thirty-three times and magnifies Him thirty-three times, and completes the hundred with lā ilāha illallāh…, his sins are forgiven even if they are like the foam of the sea.

items.title: Seeking forgiveness
items.arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ
items.transliteration: Astaghfirullāh.
items.translation: I seek the forgiveness of Allah.

items.title: You are Peace
items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ السَّلَامُ وَمِنْكَ السَّلَامُ، تَبَارَكْتَ يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ
items.transliteration: Allāhumma antas-salāmu wa minkas-salām, tabārakta yā dhal-jalāli wal-ikrām.
items.translation: O Allah, You are Peace and from You comes peace. Blessed are You, O Possessor of majesty and honour.

items.title: None can withhold what You give
items.arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، اللَّهُمَّ لَا مَانِعَ لِمَا أَعْطَيْتَ، وَلَا مُعْطِيَ لِمَا مَنَعْتَ، وَلَا يَنْفَعُ ذَا الْجَدِّ مِنْكَ الْجَدُّ
items.transliteration: Lā ilāha illallāhu waḥdahū lā sharīka lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-ḥamdu wa huwa ʿalā kulli shay'in qadīr. Allāhumma lā māniʿa limā aʿṭayt, wa lā muʿṭiya limā manaʿt, wa lā yanfaʿu dhal-jaddi minkal-jadd.
items.translation: There is no god but Allah alone, without partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is over all things capable. O Allah, none can withhold what You give, none can give what You withhold, and the wealth of the wealthy cannot avail him against You.

items.title: Tasbih
items.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ
items.transliteration: Subḥānallāh.
items.translation: Glory be to Allah.

items.title: Tahmid
items.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
items.transliteration: Al-ḥamdu lillāh.
items.translation: All praise is for Allah.

items.title: Takbir
items.arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
items.transliteration: Allāhu akbar.
items.translation: Allah is the Greatest.

items.title: Completing the hundred
items.arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
items.transliteration: Lā ilāha illallāhu waḥdahū lā sharīka lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-ḥamd, wa huwa ʿalā kulli shay'in qadīr.
items.translation: There is no god but Allah alone, without partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is over all things capable.

items.virtue: Whoever recites it after every obligatory prayer, nothing prevents him from entering Paradise except death.
Recite the three Quls after each prayer; after Fajr and Maghrib, three times each.

items.title: Help me remember You
items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَىٰ ذِكْرِكَ، وَشُكْرِكَ، وَحُسْنِ عِبَادَتِكَ
items.transliteration: Allāhumma aʿinnī ʿalā dhikrika wa shukrika wa ḥusni ʿibādatik.
items.translation: O Allah, help me to remember You, to thank You, and to worship You well.

collections.title: Before sleep
collections.subtitle: As you lie down at night

completion.headline:
Rest now,
in His keeping
completion.quote: When you go to your bed, recite Ayat al-Kursi, and a guardian from Allah will remain with you, and no devil will come near you until morning.

items.virtue: Cup your hands, recite the three Quls, blow into them, and wipe over as much of your body as you can. Do this three times.
A guardian from Allah remains with you and no devil comes near you until morning.

items.title: The last two verses of al-Baqarah
items.arabic: آمَنَ الرَّسُولُ بِمَا أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ رَبِّهِ وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ ۚ كُلٌّ آمَنَ بِاللَّهِ وَمَلَائِكَتِهِ وَكُتُبِهِ وَرُسُلِهِ لَا نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ أَحَدٍ مِنْ رُسُلِهِ ۚ وَقَالُوا سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا ۖ غُفْرَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ ۝٢٨٥ لَا يُكَلِّفُ اللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا ۚ لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَعَلَيْهَا مَا اكْتَسَبَتْ ۗ رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَا إِنْ نَسِينَا أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَا إِصْرًا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِ ۖ وَاعْفُ عَنَّا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا ۚ أَنْتَ مَوْلَانَا فَانْصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ ۝٢٨٦
items.transliteration: Āmanar-rasūlu bimā unzila ilayhi mir-rabbihī wal-mu'minūn. Kullun āmana billāhi wa malā'ikatihī wa kutubihī wa rusulih, lā nufarriqu bayna aḥadim-mir-rusulih. Wa qālū samiʿnā wa aṭaʿnā, ghufrānaka rabbanā wa ilaykal-maṣīr. Lā yukallifullāhu nafsan illā wusʿahā, lahā mā kasabat wa ʿalayhā maktasabat. Rabbanā lā tu'ākhidhnā in nasīnā aw akhṭa'nā. Rabbanā wa lā taḥmil ʿalaynā iṣran kamā ḥamaltahū ʿalal-ladhīna min qablinā. Rabbanā wa lā tuḥammilnā mā lā ṭāqata lanā bih, waʿfu ʿannā waghfir lanā warḥamnā, anta mawlānā fanṣurnā ʿalal-qawmil-kāfirīn.
items.translation: The Messenger believes in what was sent down to him from his Lord, and so do the believers. Each believes in Allah, His angels, His books and His messengers: "We make no distinction between any of His messengers." And they say, "We hear and we obey. Grant us Your forgiveness, our Lord; to You is the final return." Allah does not burden a soul beyond what it can bear. It will have the good it has earned, and bear the evil it has earned. "Our Lord, do not hold us to account if we forget or make a mistake. Our Lord, do not place on us a burden like the one You placed on those before us. Our Lord, do not burden us with more than we can bear. Pardon us, forgive us, and have mercy on us. You are our Protector, so help us against the disbelieving people."
items.virtue: Whoever recites these two verses at night, they will suffice him.

items.title: Tasbih
items.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ
items.transliteration: Subḥānallāh.
items.translation: Glory be to Allah.
items.virtue: The Prophet ﷺ taught this to Fatimah and Ali: it is better for you than a servant.

items.title: Tahmid
items.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
items.transliteration: Al-ḥamdu lillāh.
items.translation: All praise is for Allah.

items.title: Takbir
items.arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
items.transliteration: Allāhu akbar.
items.translation: Allah is the Greatest.

items.title: In Your name I lie down
items.arabic: بِاسْمِكَ رَبِّي وَضَعْتُ جَنْبِي، وَبِكَ أَرْفَعُهُ، فَإِنْ أَمْسَكْتَ نَفْسِي فَارْحَمْهَا، وَإِنْ أَرْسَلْتَهَا فَاحْفَظْهَا بِمَا تَحْفَظُ بِهِ عِبَادَكَ الصَّالِحِينَ
items.transliteration: Bismika rabbī waḍaʿtu janbī, wa bika arfaʿuh, fa-in amsakta nafsī farḥamhā, wa in arsaltahā faḥfaẓhā bimā taḥfaẓu bihī ʿibādakaṣ-ṣāliḥīn.
items.translation: In Your name, my Lord, I lie down, and by You I rise. If You take my soul, have mercy on it; and if You send it back, protect it as You protect Your righteous servants.

items.title: Protect me from Your punishment
items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ قِنِي عَذَابَكَ يَوْمَ تَبْعَثُ عِبَادَكَ
items.transliteration: Allāhumma qinī ʿadhābaka yawma tabʿathu ʿibādak.
items.translation: O Allah, protect me from Your punishment on the Day You resurrect Your servants.

items.title: I submit myself to You
items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَسْلَمْتُ نَفْسِي إِلَيْكَ، وَفَوَّضْتُ أَمْرِي إِلَيْكَ، وَوَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِي إِلَيْكَ، وَأَلْجَأْتُ ظَهْرِي إِلَيْكَ، رَغْبَةً وَرَهْبَةً إِلَيْكَ، لَا مَلْجَأَ وَلَا مَنْجَا مِنْكَ إِلَّا إِلَيْكَ، آمَنْتُ بِكِتَابِكَ الَّذِي أَنْزَلْتَ، وَبِنَبِيِّكَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلْتَ
items.transliteration: Allāhumma aslamtu nafsī ilayk, wa fawwaḍtu amrī ilayk, wa wajjahtu wajhī ilayk, wa alja'tu ẓahrī ilayk, raghbatan wa rahbatan ilayk, lā maljā'a wa lā manjā minka illā ilayk. Āmantu bi-kitābikal-ladhī anzalt, wa bi-nabiyyikal-ladhī arsalt.
items.translation: O Allah, I submit myself to You, entrust my affair to You, turn my face to You, and rely on You, in hope of You and in awe of You. There is no refuge and no escape from You except to You. I believe in Your Book which You sent down, and in Your Prophet whom You sent.
items.virtue: Make it the last thing you say. If you die that night, you die upon the fitrah.

items.title: In Your name I die and live
items.arabic: بِاسْمِكَ اللَّهُمَّ أَمُوتُ وَأَحْيَا
items.transliteration: Bismika Allāhumma amūtu wa aḥyā.
items.translation: In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live.

collections.title: On waking
collections.subtitle: The first words of the day

completion.headline:
Another day,
a gift from Him
completion.quote: All praise is for Allah who gave us life after He had caused us to die, and to Him is the resurrection.

items.title: Praise on waking
items.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ
items.transliteration: Al-ḥamdu lillāhil-ladhī aḥyānā baʿda mā amātanā wa ilayhin-nushūr.
items.translation: All praise is for Allah who gave us life after He had caused us to die, and to Him is the resurrection.

items.title: Well-being restored
items.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي عَافَانِي فِي جَسَدِي، وَرَدَّ عَلَيَّ رُوحِي، وَأَذِنَ لِي بِذِكْرِهِ
items.transliteration: Al-ḥamdu lillāhil-ladhī ʿāfānī fī jasadī, wa radda ʿalayya rūḥī, wa adhina lī bi-dhikrih.
items.translation: All praise is for Allah who restored my body to health, returned my soul to me, and permitted me to remember Him.

items.title: Waking in the night
items.arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَلَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ، رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي
items.transliteration: Lā ilāha illallāhu waḥdahū lā sharīka lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-ḥamd, wa huwa ʿalā kulli shay'in qadīr. Subḥānallāh, wal-ḥamdu lillāh, wa lā ilāha illallāh, wallāhu akbar, wa lā ḥawla wa lā quwwata illā billāh. Rabbighfir lī.
items.translation: There is no god but Allah alone, without partner; His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is over all things capable. Glory be to Allah, all praise is for Allah, there is no god but Allah, Allah is the Greatest, and there is no power and no strength except with Allah. My Lord, forgive me.
items.virtue: Whoever wakes at night and says this, then asks forgiveness, is forgiven; and if he prays, his prayer is accepted.

collections.title: Everyday duas
collections.subtitle: For the moments of the day

items.title: Leaving home
items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
items.transliteration: Bismillāh, tawakkaltu ʿalallāh, wa lā ḥawla wa lā quwwata illā billāh.
items.translation: In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah, and there is no power and no strength except with Allah.
items.virtue: It is said to him: you are guided, suffices and protected, and the devil turns away from him.

items.title: Entering home
items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ
items.transliteration: Bismillāh.
items.translation: In the name of Allah.
items.virtue: When a man mentions Allah on entering his home and at his meal, the devil says: no place to stay and no dinner for you.

items.title: Before eating
items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ
items.transliteration: Bismillāh. If you forget at the start: Bismillāhi awwalahū wa ākhirah.
items.translation: In the name of Allah. (If you forget: In the name of Allah at its beginning and its end.)

items.title: After eating
items.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنِي هَٰذَا، وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلَا قُوَّةٍ
items.transliteration: Al-ḥamdu lillāhil-ladhī aṭʿamanī hādhā, wa razaqanīhi min ghayri ḥawlim-minnī wa lā quwwah.
items.translation: All praise is for Allah who fed me this and provided it for me, without any power or strength from me.

items.title: Entering the toilet
items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْخُبُثِ وَالْخَبَائِثِ
items.transliteration: Allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika minal-khubuthi wal-khabā'ith.
items.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from evil and from those who do evil.

items.title: Leaving the toilet
items.arabic: غُفْرَانَكَ
items.transliteration: Ghufrānak.
items.translation: I ask for Your forgiveness.

items.title: Entering the mosque
items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ
items.transliteration: Allāhummaftaḥ lī abwāba raḥmatik.
items.translation: O Allah, open for me the gates of Your mercy.

items.title: Leaving the mosque
items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
items.transliteration: Allāhumma innī as'aluka min faḍlik.
items.translation: O Allah, I ask You of Your bounty.

items.title: Setting off on a journey
items.arabic: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَٰذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ، وَإِنَّا إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُونَ
items.transliteration: Subḥānal-ladhī sakhkhara lanā hādhā wa mā kunnā lahū muqrinīn, wa innā ilā rabbinā lamunqalibūn.
items.translation: Glory be to the One who has placed this at our service, when we could not have done so ourselves; and to our Lord we will surely return.

items.title: In distress
items.arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ الْعَظِيمُ الْحَلِيمُ، لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَرَبُّ الْأَرْضِ وَرَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيمِ
items.transliteration: Lā ilāha illallāhul-ʿAẓīmul-Ḥalīm, lā ilāha illallāhu rabbul-ʿarshil-ʿaẓīm, lā ilāha illallāhu rabbus-samāwāti wa rabbul-arḍi wa rabbul-ʿarshil-karīm.
items.translation: There is no god but Allah, the Mighty, the Forbearing. There is no god but Allah, Lord of the Mighty Throne. There is no god but Allah, Lord of the heavens, Lord of the earth, and Lord of the Noble Throne.

items.title: For worry and grief
items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ، وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ
items.transliteration: Allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika minal-hammi wal-ḥazan, wal-ʿajzi wal-kasal, wal-bukhli wal-jubn, wa ḍalaʿid-dayni wa ghalabatir-rijāl.
items.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from worry and grief, from helplessness and laziness, from miserliness and cowardice, and from the burden of debt and being overpowered by others.

items.title: The supplication of Yunus
items.arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
items.transliteration: Lā ilāha illā anta subḥānaka innī kuntu minaẓ-ẓālimīn.
items.translation: There is no god but You. Glory be to You; I have been among the wrongdoers.
items.virtue: No Muslim ever supplicates with it for anything except that Allah answers him.

items.title: When it rains
items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَيِّبًا نَافِعًا
items.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣayyiban nāfiʿā.
items.translation: O Allah, let it be a beneficial rain.

items.title: After sneezing
items.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
items.transliteration: Al-ḥamdu lillāh. The listener replies: Yarḥamukallāh. Then you say: Yahdīkumullāhu wa yuṣliḥu bālakum.
items.translation: All praise is for Allah. (Reply: May Allah have mercy on you. Then: May Allah guide you and set your affairs right.)
